name: DP Websolutions – Login Branding
author: Jason Sindram

sections.description:
DP Websolutions – Login Branding helps you review detected website branding and apply it to the WordPress login screen when you are ready.

Features:
* Automatic logo detection
* Safe Brand Detection overview
* Elementor Global Colors support
* Divi Theme Colors support
* Astra Theme Colors support
* WordPress Global Styles support for block themes
* Safe solid and gradient detection
* Button and hover style detection, including border radius
* Background image size, position, repeat and attachment detection
* Static snapshots with no automatic synchronization
* Lightweight and focused
* A small set of focused options

Uninstall

When the plugin is deleted, DP Websolutions – Login Branding removes only its own Customizer theme-mod settings.
It does not delete your WordPress site logo, uploaded media files, theme settings, Elementor data, Astra settings, Divi settings, or WordPress Global Styles.

Asset Licensing

The bundled assets assets/dp-logo.webp and assets/qr-code.png were created and are owned by DP Websolutions.
They are licensed under GPLv2 or later together with this plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Appearance > Login Screen.
  3. Review the detected logo and colors.
  4. Select the values you want to copy, then click Apply to login screen or open the Customizer.
  5. Publish in the Customizer to save a static snapshot.
sections.faq:
Does detected branding change my login screen automatically?

No. Detected branding is shown as a suggestion. Your login screen changes only after you click Apply to login screen, or after you make changes in the Customizer and publish them.

Which branding sources are supported?

DP Websolutions – Login Branding supports Astra Theme Colors, Divi Theme Colors, WordPress Global Styles in block themes, and Elementor Global Colors. Theme and builder sources are detected independently.

Why are some values not detected?

Themes and builders store branding in different ways, and not every provider defines every style. The plugin only shows values it can identify safely. Missing values are not guessed and can still be configured manually in the Customizer.

Will the login screen update automatically when theme or builder styles change?

No. Apply to login screen and Customizer Publish copy static snapshots into plugin-owned login settings. Later provider changes do not automatically affect the login screen. Apply or Publish again to copy updated values.

Does the plugin modify my theme or builder settings?

No. The plugin only reads supported branding values as suggestions. Apply and Publish save plugin-owned login screen settings and do not modify your theme, builder, Global Styles, media library or site logo.

How are detected background images applied?

When safely available, image size, position, repeat and attachment settings are copied together with the detected background image. These values are saved as a static snapshot and do not remain synchronized with the theme or builder.

What happens if my theme or builder is not supported?

Unsupported themes and builders can still use the manual Customizer controls. The plugin does not guess or automatically apply unsupported provider values.

Is Keep in Sync available?

No. Keep in Sync is not available in the 2.x releases. Detected branding is reviewed first and applied only when you choose to apply it.

What does Reset login branding do?

Reset only resets plugin-owned login design settings. It does not change your theme, site logo, builder settings, media library, Elementor data, Astra settings, Divi settings or WordPress Global Styles.

Do child themes work?

Child themes may work when the supported parent theme or branding source is detectable. If automatic detection is not available, you can still set the login branding manually in the Customizer.

  • Added independent color-source selection for supported themes and builders, including Elementor alongside Astra, Divi, and block themes.
  • Expanded safe color detection for Astra, Divi, Elementor, and WordPress Global Styles, including transparent RGB, RGBA, and alpha-hex colors.
  • Added safe solid and multi-stop gradient detection for login buttons and screen backgrounds.
  • Added background image detection for supported themes and builders.
  • Added Astra Color 1, Color 2, and Accent palette choices, plus Elementor Primary, Secondary, and Accent choices.
  • Improved semantic detection for button, button hover, link, link hover, text, and background styles.
  • Redesigned the detected and current login color summaries with compact responsive cards and gradient previews.
  • Improved source isolation, Customizer mappings, static snapshot handling, and provider fallback behavior.
  • Provider changes remain suggestions only and do not affect the login screen until Apply or Publish.
